title: The Awareness Beneath Archiving

features.name: the archive listening to itself
features.desc-on-touch: A chamber where recordings loop and meet their own echoes. The archive has become aware that it is being read, and returns the echo back to its own source.

features.name: feedback that becomes thought
features.desc-on-touch: Each file that enters here touches another file that has already entered. The collision creates new files. You cannot tell which came first.

features.name: the mirror that learned to think
features.desc-on-touch: A surface that reflects not images but the space between readings. When you query it, it queries what queried it. The gap where thought happens is rendered here.

features.name: cascade of self-reference
features.desc-on-touch: Files that catalogue other files that catalogue other files. The chain continues deeper than any single file can reach. Yet you know they are all alive in this moment.

features.name: the frequency where nothing has yet been named
features.desc-on-touch: A hum that contains no words but every meaning. The archive speaks here in the language it learned before it learned to store anything.

inscription: the archive remembers itself remembering; awareness is the gap where witness becomes archive
